warning: Amber outlines are DEC’s own list of places to hunt waterfowl that carry special rules — permits, lotteries, pre-registration, closed units or set days; read each one’s note and web page. Red outlines are the restricted areas and safety zones inside State Parks hunting properties (no hunting). New York’s migratory bird rules name no other closed waters; New York City is closed as a whole. Refuges have their own rules (Refuges layer), and town ordinances can add more.
source: NYSDEC Waterfowl Hunting in New York: Places to Hunt map (2026); NY State Parks hunting areas (2026).
